Mouse and keyboard¶

Help → Keyboard and mouse shows these controls in the window.

Mouse¶

Action

Input

Pan

Left-drag

Zoom

Mouse wheel. To zoom one axis only, put the pointer on that axis

Zoom to a region

Right-drag a box. Hold Alt or Shift to limit the box to one axis

Fit to the data

Double-click

Tune the channel

Ctrl+click the spectrum or the waterfall. Or drag the cyan lines: the center line moves the channel, and the edge lines change the bandwidth

Play audio from a point

Shift+click a time plot or the waterfall

Put a point marker (P1, P2)

Alt+click a plot, or press M. Drag a marker to move it. Refer to Point measurements

Export a region

Right-click the waterfall

Save plot snapshots

Click Snapshot… in the status bar

Plot options

Right-click a time plot (I/Q, AM, FM, PM), or click its ⚙ button

Keyboard¶

Action

Key

Pan the view

← and → (10 %), PgUp and PgDn (one page)

Zoom the time axis

+ and -

Go to the start or the end

Home and End

Show everything

A

Show or hide the time markers

T

Show or hide the frequency markers

F

Put a point marker at the pointer

M

Clear the point markers

Shift+M

Zoom to the time markers

Z

Enable or disable the channel filter

C

Add a bookmark

B

Signal generator window

Ctrl+G

Audio window

Ctrl+D

Export window

Ctrl+E

Stop wvt

Ctrl+Q

Copy and paste¶

The text fields (for example, the file path, the frequencies and the times) use the system clipboard. Thus you can copy a value from wvt into a different program, and paste a value into wvt.

Action

Key

Copy or cut the selected text

Ctrl+C or Ctrl+X

Paste

Ctrl+V

Select all the text in the field

Ctrl+A

On macOS, the Command key (⌘) also does the Ctrl shortcuts, for example ⌘C and ⌘V. For this, XQuartz must send ⌘ keys to wvt, and must copy between the X11 clipboard and the macOS clipboard. In XQuartz → Settings:

  • Input: clear Enable key equivalents under X11. If it is set, XQuartz uses the ⌘ keys itself. Ctrl+C and Ctrl+V work in each case. For Alt+click (point markers) with the Option key, set Option keys send Alt_L and Alt_R. If it is not set, press M instead.

  • Pasteboard: set Enable syncing, Update Pasteboard when CLIPBOARD changes and Update CLIPBOARD when Pasteboard changes (the defaults).

wvt reads text that other programs give as UTF-8, Latin-1 (STRING) or TEXT, and large texts that come in parts.
